Pralhad Joshi Takes Charge as India's Education Minister

Pralhad Joshi has taken charge as the Union Education Minister, assuming the additional responsibility following Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Upon assuming office, Joshi held a review meeting with senior officials to discuss the ministry's functioning. He expressed gratitude for the new responsibility and stated it was a new subject for him. The appointment follows weeks of protests concerning exam scandals.
